fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized time when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Provides one common time value for correlation across sources.

source_mapping.network: timestamp or derived from source timestamp

fields.name: hostname
fields.justification: Identifies the host involved in the event.

source_mapping.network: hostname when present; otherwise derived from network source

fields.name: source_type
fields.justification: Allows downstream analysis to distinguish Windows, Linux, and network telemetry.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: Normalized category assigned to the event.
fields.justification: Provides a consistent category for detection rules and triage.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity when the source provides one.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to prioritize higher-risk events.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived from event_id when a severity mapping exists

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account explicitly associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports investigation of account activity without inventing identity data.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Process name when supplied by the source.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Process identifier when supplied by the source.
fields.justification: Helps correlate activity from the same process.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address when supplied by the source.
fields.justification: Supports source attribution and network correlation.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source network port when supplied by the source.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address when supplied by the source.
fields.justification: Supports outbound and lateral connection analysis.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination network port when supplied by the source.
fields.justification: Supports detection of connections to specific services.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network protocol when supplied by the source.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Source event identifier preserved as a string.
fields.justification: Preserves identifiers consistently even when different sources use different identifier formats.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Source component that generated the event when available.
fields.justification: Preserves generator context needed to interpret source events.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Complete original event representation preserved as text.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to verify normalized data against the original evidence.

source_mapping.network: complete original network record serialized as text

fields.name: event_data
fields.description: Additional structured fields retained from the source event.
fields.justification: Preserves source-specific evidence that has no dedicated normalized field.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Identifies the provenance class of the event.
fields.justification: Distinguishes evidence-pack records from student telemetry.
